elaine_cs: Orpheus onboarding just spiked token burn ~4x overnight, embeddings dominated traffic. Need a short-term cost guard and a QBR note.
derek_finops: Got it. Can we get route breakout and a 7-day projection at this rate?
nina_se: Quick pull: /v1/embeddings ~83% of tokens, current ~2.2M tokens/day -> 7d ~15.4M. Looks like their periodic full-index job kicked off.
elaine_cs: Immediate triage: 1) temporary credit cushion, 2) route-level soft throttle, 3) flip to snapshot-mode for indexer, 4) schedule 30-min enablement tomorrow AM.
derek_finops: I'll provision a 25% buffer and create alerts at 70%/90% of that buffer. I'll add cost delta to QBR slide.
sam_enable: I can run enablement: batching, partial refresh, TTLs for cached vectors. Morning PT works.
nina_se: Implementing route cap now -> /v1/embeddings cap = 900k tokens/day. Enabling snapshot-mode cache for the job.
alert-bot: Created alert "orpheus-embed-cushion-70-90" (ID RB-9933). Playbook attached.
alert-bot: Playbook:
```
1) grant 25% credit buffer
2) set /v1/embeddings -> 900k tokens/day soft cap
3) enable snapshot caching for indexer
4) schedule enablement + follow-up in 24h
```
derek_finops: Cushion provisioned and alerts active; adding account note "temp cushion until follow-up".
elaine_cs: Please add one-line root cause hypothesis + mitigation + next steps for the QBR packet. Make it super concise.
nina_se: Draft: "Root cause: full reindex overwhelmed embeddings route; Mitigation: snapshot cache + soft cap + enablement; Outcome: projected burn down to ~0.65M tokens/day."
derek_finops: I'll add $ impact and cushion math to slide.
sam_enable: Will record session and attach 1-page playbook (batching snippet, TTL recs).
elaine_cs: Owners: derek_finops -> cushion & slide, nina_se -> cap & cache, sam_enable -> enablement. I'll re-evaluate renewal flag after 24h. (reacted :white_check_mark:)
